summary: On S248 at 3600 s (248 paired circuits), a minus b is -0.0032 in mean fidelity, -0.73 pp in mean CX reduction and -0.39 pp in mean total reduction; by total gate count a is better on 21, equal on 135 and worse on 92 circuits (Wilcoxon p = 3.57e-10; CX: 20/152/76, p = 4.7e-07). On S248 at 60 s (248 paired circuits), a minus b is -0.0021 in mean fidelity, -0.59 pp in mean CX reduction and -0.15 pp in mean total reduction; by total gate count a is better on 10, equal on 186 and worse on 52 circuits (Wilcoxon p = 2.42e-05; CX: 11/189/48, p = 0.000144). On S26 at 3600 s (26 paired circuits), a minus b is -0.0026 in mean fidelity, -0.97 pp in mean CX reduction and -0.46 pp in mean total reduction; by total gate count a is better on 3, equal on 12 and worse on 11 circuits (Wilcoxon p = 0.0464; CX: 4/12/10, p = 0.133). The run-to-run SD of config a's 26-circuit mean total reduction across seeds [0, 1, 2] is 0.12 pp (range 0.24 pp), measured on S26 at 3600 s; the a - b differences in mean total reduction are 3.1 (S248 at 3600 s), 1.2 (S248 at 60 s), 3.7 (S26 at 3600 s) times that SD in absolute value (Section 5 gives the same ratios for fidelity and CX reduction). Of the headline statements with a crisp condition and data, 16 have the same outcome under both configurations; none differ.
